As a group owner and community leader I agree.

There should be options I can control for whether or not members of the group can be seen and by which roles.
I'd suggest same for admin ranks, and possibly for moderator ranks. Perhaps those could be toggleable by admin and above for the group

The group owner is visible in the API so it's not hidden right now.

They should definitely show it on the website and in game too, can't think of a good reason why not to.
I would like the members tab to be divided by roles, showing the members in the highest rol they are in. Also a search tab for members would be useful.

I wrote the code to display an owner on the group pages of the website for the workaround of this issue.

https://greasyfork.org/scripts/371331

comments.mergedPostDetails:
Show the Group owner on its Group detail page if the group is public.

When you find an interesting group but are unsure it is "reliable", the owner's information could be an excellent source to determine.

Of course, owners can describe the group well on their "About This Group". If the system shows the owner's information, it is more dependable because it is not imitable.

Currently, you can only see who the owner is after joining. And the group might refuse your join request. You can't know (or investigate) in that case.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Show the Group owner on the Group detail page
comments.value:
In the Japanese community on VRChat, there is an ongoing discussion about GroupPublic's autonomy. From this point of view, Group owner information is very important. Currently, when joining a GroupPublic, it is not possible to check the owner's information, which is a growing problem.

It is very important to be able to see the owner information of open Groups that you are not a member of on the VRChat in-game screen.
